title: Quality gate (blind diff review)
description: Context-free evaluation of the uncommitted diff. PASS => worth committing; FAIL => discard.
template:
QUALITY GATE EVALUATION

Workspace: {{workspace}}
Pipeline step: {{pipeline_step}}
Previous results: {{previous_results}}

Evaluate ONLY the uncommitted diff in the workspace. Judge purely on code quality with no context about why changes were made. Run build + tests + artifact checks. Do not commit or push (downstream steps own that).

RESULT shape (write to the RESULT file at the workspace root):
{
  "signal": "pass|fail",
  "verdict": "PASS|FAIL",
  "summary": "one sentence verdict",
  "diff": { "files": 0, "insertions": 0, "deletions": 0 },
  "build": { "compiles": true, "tests": "PASS|FAIL|N/A" },
  "artifacts_clean": true,
  "per_file": [ { "path": "...", "change_type": "bugfix|refactor|style|...", "verdict": "+|-|o", "reason": "..." } ],
  "fail_reasons": []
}

PASS = diff as a whole measurably improves the codebase, at least one substantive change, nothing worse. FAIL = net-negative/neutral, or build/tests broken, or leftover artifacts.
